property_summary: For any admissible transfer, after a successful ERC721 transferFrom(from,to,id) the token's owner must become `to`; the mutant writes `from` back so c.ownerOf(id) still returns the old owner for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace `_ownerOf[id] = to;` with `_ownerOf[id] = from;` so ownership never moves to the recipient.
